Family dies after encountering trouble in the sea

A family of four drowned after encountering difficulties in the sea off Shoreham beach. The inquest heard that the family, including a six-year-old girl, got into trouble while in the water. Emergency services were called to the scene, but all four were pronounced dead. The circumstances leading to them getting into trouble in the sea are being investigated.
